purpose: S1 execution protocol. Written BEFORE data collection and training; not rewritten afterwards.

gates.S1-C_and_D_require: S1-A and S1-B engineering gates passed; otherwise training is marked BLOCKED

loss_definition.effective_batch: every microbatch inside one optimizer update
loss_definition.d_i: 1 if the state has >1 legal action else 0
loss_definition.explicitly_not: per-microbatch mean then unweighted average of microbatch means
loss_definition.optimizer: AdamW unchanged, effective batch 32, gradient clip once per update, clip threshold unchanged
loss_definition.tail_window: discarded as before; the number of dropped rows is recorded
loss_definition.loss_revision: introduced by S1-A and recorded in run.json and every checkpoint

validation_aggregation.method: accumulate true numerators and denominators over the full validation split, normalise at the end
validation_aggregation.invariance_required: result must not change with validation batch size or sample order (float tolerance)
validation_aggregation.kl_dev: per battle mean decision KL, then mean over battles that have decision states
validation_aggregation.teacher_entropy: same denominator as the decision KL
validation_aggregation.truncation: validation_batches is set to cover the whole split; coverage is reported, not assumed

checkpoint_selection.reporting: selected and last are reported separately with their own step and SHA256, never mixed

outcome_label_source.train: behaviour continuation (sample_actions=true) - the episode's own ending is written to every state
outcome_label_source.consequence: the two splits use different continuation rules; cross-continuation scores are diagnostics only

intent_semantics.target: public intent classes at the granularity the game shows
intent_semantics.deliverable: input/intent_mapping.csv with monster, internal move (audit only), public class, source, test location, verification level
intent_semantics.prohibited: exporting the internal move id under a new field name
intent_semantics.versioning: observation schema and encoding revision are bumped; old replay and old checkpoints must not load silently

sampler_audit.acceptance: every latent field that can affect the future is classified with a reason; UNSUPPORTED branches stop and are reported
sampler_audit.counterfactual: identical complete public history with different hidden state, when reachable; otherwise a stated deterministic argument plus uncovered boundary
sampler_audit.not_accepted_as_proof: random collision scans, or the absence of a move_id key

evaluation.scenarios: the 256 already-materialised development scenarios in the repository, reused not regenerated
evaluation.latency: per-decision timings are saved; pooled p50/p95 over all decisions, plus the median of per-episode p50/p95 named as such
evaluation.pairing: per scenario; 20000 paired bootstrap replicates, seed 20260918, conditional on the fixed models
evaluation.scope: unverified simulator pilot, single seed, development only

may_claim: public input semantics are correct to the declared scope
one new baseline with a loadable weight and per-episode evidence
may_not_claim: that a difference is caused by any single factor, since interface, counting and data all changed
